verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same layout. The building photo has been shrunk to a thin, cropped sliver at the left edge, which makes the key image trivial. Its pale band runs behind the headline. The headline breaks into five ragged lines with leading so tight that the 'y' descender crashes into 'not'. A sits low on the canvas, leaving a large dead area at the top. B is better centred vertically, which gives it slightly better balance, but it has the same collisions and the same loss of the image.
